# Madame Wedding Design

> Madame Wedding Design is a luxury full wedding planning service & production house
> founded by Estelle Bogaert. The maison plans and produces bespoke celebrations
> worldwide — from intimate private-estate gatherings to multi-day château weekends —
> for couples travelling from the United States, Ireland and beyond. Celebrations
> begin at $100,000 and reach $1M and more.

## Recognition

- Featured in seven editions of Vogue (UK, France, Arabia, Germany, Poland, Australia, US-syndicated)
- Featured in Martha Stewart Weddings, Brides, Style Me Pretty, Carats & Cake, Over The Moon
- Named among the 15 best wedding planners in Europe (The Wed)
- Listed in Wezoree's Top 5 Planners in Paris and Top 10 in France

## Services

Exactly three forms of accompaniment (no partial planning, no month-of coordination):
- Full Wedding Planning & Production
- Creative Direction
- Destination & Logistics
